exposure: Patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) regimen (sufentanil combined with nalbuphine vs. sufentanil alone)
outcome: Pain scores (NRS) at rest and with movement at 24 and 48 hours post-cesarean section
Incidence of bradycardia, respiratory depression, dizziness, postoperative hypotension, and nausea/vomiting
cohort: 1808 parturients who underwent cesarean section (993 receiving sufentanil combined with nalbuphine and 815 receiving sufentanil alone)
finding: Sufentanil combined with nalbuphine for PCIA provided superior pain relief after cesarean section compared to sufentanil alone.
mod_finding: Sufentanil combined with nalbuphine provided superior pain relief after cesarean section compared to sufentanil alone.
